name: AGI Fruit
notes: It is used to create additional stat points, or reassign existing stat points.
Most characters can create up to x127 additional stat points.
This item can be crafted from a Jewel of Creation and a Jewel of Chaos through NPC Chaos Goblin Machine.

When using this item, you can choose to either add or reassign stat points. Sometimes there is a chance to fail adding or reassigning stat points. The success rate is displayed in the character menu, towards the top of the menu. The success rate will decrease as you add or reassign stat points from your character.
You must remove all equipment before using the item.

Occasionally, there will be a promotional event which will reset the count of how many stat points you've reassigned. This will allow you to use more stat fruits in order to reassign additional stat points again as part of a promotional free-to-play event.

name: COM Fruit
notes: It is used to create additional stat points, or reassign existing stat points.
Most characters can create up to x127 additional stat points.
This item can be crafted from a Jewel of Creation and a Jewel of Chaos through NPC Chaos Goblin Machine.

When using this item, you can choose to either add or reassign stat points. Sometimes there is a chance to fail adding or reassigning stat points. The success rate is displayed in the character menu, towards the top of the menu. The success rate will decrease as you add or reassign stat points from your character.
You must remove all equipment before using the item.

Occasionally, there will be a promotional event which will reset the count of how many stat points you've reassigned. This will allow you to use more stat fruits in order to reassign additional stat points again as part of a promotional free-to-play event.

name: ENG Fruit
notes: It is used to create additional stat points, or reassign existing stat points.
Most characters can create up to x127 additional stat points.
This item can be crafted from a Jewel of Creation and a Jewel of Chaos through NPC Chaos Goblin Machine.

When using this item, you can choose to either add or reassign stat points. Sometimes there is a chance to fail adding or reassigning stat points. The success rate is displayed in the character menu, towards the top of the menu. The success rate will decrease as you add or reassign stat points from your character.
You must remove all equipment before using the item.

Occasionally, there will be a promotional event which will reset the count of how many stat points you've reassigned. This will allow you to use more stat fruits in order to reassign additional stat points again as part of a promotional free-to-play event.

name: Wizard's Ring
notes: This item's durability decreases every 60 seconds the item is equipped. It cannot be repaired. When it reaches zero durability, it is destroyed.
You can only have one Wizard's Ring in the character's inventory at the same time. However, you can put them in your personal store or vault to be able to pick up another one.
This item cannot be traded. It can be sold in personal store and stored in vault.
This item is obtained during the White Wizard invasion.

name: Wizard's Soul Shard
notes: Quest item; it is obtained during the Treasures of MU quest.
This is a quest item; this item only drops from monsters if you have accepted the quest associated with it.
Cannot be traded; cannot be sold in personal store; cannot be stored in the vault. This item only appears in the quest's story for Dark Wizard characters.

name: Wrath Scroll
notes: You can learn more about this basic skill in the Grow Lancer guide. Your character can learn the skill by right-clicking the item, but only if your character meets the skill's prerequisites.
